title: Suffixes -s, -es, -ed, -ing
examples: What is the sound for the past tense?
Can you show me how to add -ing?

explain.say: A suffix is an ending you add to a word. It changes the meaning a little.
Add s to mean more than one. One book becomes two books.
If a word ends in s, x, sh or ch, add es. One box becomes two boxes.

draw.text: Plurals: add -es after s, x, sh, ch   box → boxes

explain.say: Add ed when something has already happened. Walk becomes walked.
Add ing when something is happening now. Play becomes playing.
The ending ed can sound like t, d or id. Listen: jumped, played, painted.

faq.q: When do I use -es instead of just -s?
faq.a: You use -es when the word ends in s, x, sh or ch, as in buses, boxes, dishes and benches. You can hear the extra beat.
asks: Do I add -es to words like bus?

faq.q: How do I know if a past tense verb needs -ed?
faq.a: Most verbs just need -ed at the end, as in jumped. A few change in other ways, like run and ran.
asks: What is the past tense sound?
Do I always say -ed for past tense?

faq.q: Is '-ing' always for actions happening now?
faq.a: Usually, yes. The -ing ending shows an action that is going on, as in I am playing.

faq.q: Do I have to change the spelling when adding these endings?
faq.a: Sometimes. In a short word like hop, you double the last letter: hopping and hopped.

faq.q: What is the difference between plurals and past tense?
faq.a: A plural tells you there is more than one thing. The past tense tells you an action has already happened.

facts: Past tense verbs often end with -ed.
The -ing ending shows an action happening now.
If a word ends in 's', 'x', 'sh' or 'ch', add -es to make the plural.

quiz.say: Look at the two cats. Tap the ending you need.
quiz.why: Cat ends in t, so you just add s.

wrong.0: You add es after s, x, sh or ch, and cat ends in t.
wrong.2: The ending ed is for something that already happened.

quiz.say: Look at the two foxes. Tap the ending you need.
quiz.why: Fox ends in x, so you add es.

wrong.0: Fox ends in x, so it needs es, which adds a beat.
wrong.1: The ending ing is for something happening now.

quiz.say: Read the sentence. Tap the ending for the gap.
quiz.why: Yesterday is in the past, so you add ed to make played.

wrong.1: The ending s is for now, as in Mei plays football.
wrong.2: The ending ing is for something happening now.
